resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com date the 30-foot tower to 1937; Kemnow's September 1937 item shows construction under way and his timeline lists completion in 1938. The story gives 1937 as the build year and 1938 as the completion Kemnow records.

Register and firelookout.com name the Coos FPA; Kemnow's 1934 item calls the station a state forestry lookout station, and his 1930 item says the State Forester was building it. The story reports both names and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Kemnow's page is a compiled timeline that quotes the Curry County Reporter, Coos Bay Times, Siskiyou Bulletin, and a 1942 inspection report. Those were read only as Kemnow quotes them. The register's 'hurricane' and Kemnow's 'storm' describe the same 1962 event, so the story uses 'storm'. The 1935 Forest Service letter on Lot 9, Section 14 (reserving the land as the Brushy Bald Lookout site) is not in the story. Nothing read describes the site today or its access, so facts.access and visit are omitted. Used 2 WebSearch (no new relevant hits) and about 5 page reads.
